tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL (page or PDF) as clean markdown. Pass `question` to get only the passages answering it instead of the whole page - far cheaper than reading the full body into context.

url.description: Page or PDF URL, or up to 5 URLs to read in parallel.

withAllLinks.description: Also return every link on the page.

withAllImages.description: Also return every image on the page.

question.description: Return only the passages answering this question, instead of the full body. Omit for the whole page.

chunk_size.description: Passage size in words, default 100. Larger gives more surrounding context, smaller pinpoints the answer. Comparable across scripts. Needs `question`.

ocr.description: Read the rendered page as an image with jina-ocr-v1 instead of its HTML. Use for scanned documents and PDFs whose text is not in the markup, and to keep formulas and table structure. Parses ONE page per call, page 1 unless `page` says otherwise, and costs about 40x the tokens per page, so leave off unless the HTML path has failed you.

page.description: Which page the OCR pass should parse, 1-based. Needs `ocr`; the HTML path returns the whole document at once.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search the web. Returns titles, URLs and search-engine snippets.

tbs.description: Age limit: qdr:h, qdr:d, qdr:w, qdr:m, qdr:y (hour to year).
